issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Race Condition Specs for Registry
issues.why: The spec mentions a 'master registry' and 'collision resolution' but lacks the technical contract for how concurrent CI/CD pipelines or multiple developers prevent ID collisions during the registration phase.
issues.fix: Add a Normative Contract section in 03-error-code-registry defining a 'First-to-Merge' lock or a pre-commit reservation protocol.

issues.title: Unresolved Downstream Application References
issues.why: AC-08 and AC-09 explicitly acknowledge that references to 'backend/internal/...' will fail in this context because they live in downstream repos, creating a 'harness-artifact' gap for a mediocre AI.
issues.fix: Provide a mock file-tree or a 'Contract-Only' interface for the expected backend directory structure within the spec context.

issues.title: GWT Gap for Error Resolution Workflow API
issues.why: The Phase 60 OpenAPI for Error Resolution (tickets) is provided as a normative reference but lacks a corresponding GWT acceptance test in 97-acceptance-criteria.md.
issues.fix: Add AC-10: Error Resolution Ticket Lifecycle, verifying ticket creation and status transitions via the defined OpenAPI schema.
